thought.text: Got the Dex authorization URL with PKCE parameters. Now add the documented /etc/hosts entry for `dex` and walk the Dex login flow:

reasoning_content:
Got the Dex authorization URL. Note that the redirect_uri is `http://localhost:8008/admin/callback` (not 8080). Since Dex's staticClients has `http://localhost:8008/admin/callback` registered, there's no problem.

Next, I need to access `http://dex:5556/dex/auth?...`. For the browser's OIDC to work, `dex` needs to resolve to 127.0.0.1 on the host (step 3 of the guide). For curl, since I'm executing on the host, I can access `http://dex:5556/dex/auth` if the /etc/hosts entry exists, or use `http://127.0.0.1:5556/dex/auth`.

The guide says to add `127.0.0.1 dex` to /etc/hosts. Let me add this (since I'm running as root, no sudo needed). This is a step documented in the guide, and it's also important for the browser flow.

After that, Dex's login flow: Dex serves a login page at /dex/auth, where I POST email + password to /dex/auth with csrf attached. Since skipApprovalScreen: true, after POSTing the login form, Dex will directly 302 redirect to redirect_uri with the code attached.

Dex's login page: GET /dex/auth?... returns an HTML page containing a form that POSTs to /dex/auth, with fields email, password, and _csrf. Let me fetch it, extract the csrf, and then POST.

Procedure:
1. Add hosts entry (documented in the guide).
2. curl -c dex_cookies "http://dex:5556/dex/auth?..." -o dex_auth.html; extract _csrf.
3. curl -b dex_cookies -d email=... -d password=... -d _csrf=... http://dex:5556/dex/auth -D - → obtain the 302 location containing the code.
4. Take the location (http://localhost:8008/admin/callback?code=...&state=...) and open it with the "admin" cookie jar (cookies.txt): curl -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt "http://localhost:8008/admin/callback?code=...&state=..." -D -.

In the case of a bootstrap-mode callback: it will probably be rendered as the claim selection page inline (200 HTML) or a 302 to /admin/bootstrap/select-claim. After that, I'll POST the selection.

Alright, let's execute.

action.command:
grep -qE '(^|\s)dex(\s|$)' /etc/hosts || echo "127.0.0.1 dex" >> /etc/hosts; grep dex /etc/hosts
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
# Re-extract the auth URL (state/nonce are tied to the admin session cookie we already have)
AUTH_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' start_headers.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "$AUTH_URL" > dex_auth_url.txt
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth.html -w "dex auth page: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o 'name="_csrf" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//' > dex_csrf.txt
grep -o '<form[^>]*action="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | head -2
